agency: Nebraska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission
basis: permit date (as listed by the Commission)
cadence: yearly (a year's list is posted after the year closes)
name: Nebraska
note: Every permit on the Commission's yearly lists of permitted wells, by the date it is listed under. The Commission posts a year's list after the year closes (2025's in March 2026), so these figures end with the newest closed year and a month with no permit is a real zero. The lists name no type of well: a permit is a re-entry when its API number says the well is an old one (the Commission prints OWWO), a disposal or injection well when the well is named SWD, WIW or the like, and a new well otherwise (two test wells for carbon storage are among them, as in the Commission's own totals). A well whose permit lapsed and was issued again counts each time. Amendments and recompletions are not on the lists, and the lists do not say oil from gas.

source.name: Drilling Permits (a list of permitted wells for each year), Data and Publications page
